items.item_text: Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM) Certification preferred
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, preferably in business or related field or a combination of experience, education or training.
At least two years progressive administrative experience in academic healthcare, including calendaring, meeting coordination and events planning.
Previous experience working with physicians in a healthcare setting.
At least two years experience in human resources and/or faculty recruitment, including search preparation and support, interview scheduling, hiring processes, and onboarding.
Experience using MyInfoVault, APHID, RECRUIT, PeopleAdmin and/or other online systems/apps used for academic advancement and physician and staff recruitment.
Experience providing administrative support to faculty, managers or high level executives.
Experience working with VISA’s with knowledge of J1 or HIB visas, including processing of necessary documents for employment of foreign visiting scientists and scholars.

The Academic HR Analyst 2 position will work closely with the Division Manager and Leadership and collaboratively with the Division's Academic Personnel Supervisor to provide expertise in recruitment, personnel onboarding, faculty development, VISA management, and other processes to assist with personnel administration at various levels. The position reports to Division Manager, who is responsible for Division academic, clinical, educational and research activities.
30% - ACADEMIC PERSONNEL ADMINISTRATION - Faculty
Demonstrated excellent writing, spelling, editing and proofreading skills to quickly and accurately produce professional and accurate correspondence and other written materials.
Demonstrated knowledge of HR principles and practices in order to interpret, understand, and apply policies and procedures.
Demonstrated strong, proactive communication skills with the ability to clearly convey information and ideas through a variety of media to diverse audiences.
Demonstrated, thorough knowledge of UC Davis and School of Medicine policies and procedures related to academic personnel and staff recruitment, HR policies, hiring, and other personnel actions.
Demonstrated strong attention to detail skills.
Demonstrated exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated ability to continually learn and grow, quickly and effectively learning to use new tools and apps, systems and processes in a continually changing environment.
Demonstrated advanced skills using Microsoft Word, Outlook and Teams.
Intermediate skills using Microsoft Excel.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and use various software applications.
Demonstrated analytical skills to evaluate information such as funding, payroll and other data, with the ability to formulate logical and objective conclusions.
Demonstrated ability to take initiative, working independently or effectively as part of a team.
Demonstrated strong time management and multitasking skills.
Demonstrated proactive problem-solving ability using colleagues, online resources, and good judgment.
Demonstrated strong organizational, administrative, and technical skills to assume general assignments and independently follow through to successful completion.
Demonstrated political acumen to work in an executive-level office environment, with ability to represent the Division and faculty with professionalism, tact and discretion to all constituents.
Ability to anticipate problems/ roadblocks and associated consequences, and take appropriate initiative on behalf of the division manager, supervisor and faculty.
